vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1799 — implement Open-Q2 canonical contract publish surface.

plan.title: Implement Open-Q2: publish canonical contract layer

narratives.Description: Deliver the locked Open-Q2 decision (#1799): downstream TS and non-TS consumers import the canonical vBRIEF/policy contract from `@deftai/directive-types` and published JSON Schema artifacts instead of hand-mirroring shapes. Replace the #1717 Wave-1 skeleton (`EngineInfo` placeholder) with real contract types, ship schema files from npm, add a deterministic TS↔schema drift gate, and document the supported public API boundary (contract-only; behavior stays CLI). Reconcile npm reality: `@deftai/directive-core` may remain on the registry for the install dependency graph but is explicitly unsupported as a library API.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Define the v1 public contract surface in `packages/types/` — vBRIEF document model (`vBRIEFInfo`, `plan`, items, narratives, references with `x-vbrief/*`), typed `plan.policy` fields consumers mirror today, and gate result/exit-code types where downstream tools need them. Honor deftai/vBRIEF#12 extension namespace (`^x-[a-z0-9-]+/`) and preserve-verbatim round-trip semantics.
2. Bundle JSON Schema artifacts in `@deftai/directive-types` (subpath exports): minimum `vbrief-core-0.6.schema.json` sourced from `content/vbrief/schemas/vbrief-core.schema.json`; document v1 vs follow-up for auxiliary schemas (`candidates`, `cache-meta`, pack schemas).
3. Add `verify:contract-drift` (or extend an existing gate) — fail closed when TS types, published schema copies, and `content/vbrief/schemas/` diverge.
4. Update consumer docs (README / UPGRADING / content/conventions): import examples for `@deftai/directive-types`, `$schema` / `$id` usage for non-TS, and clarify single source of truth vs install-time `vbrief/schemas/` mirror.
5. Document `@deftai/directive-core` as published-but-unsupported (no semver guarantee on deep imports); supported public contract = types + schemas only.
6. Verify release path: `npm pack @deftai/directive-types` includes types + schemas; `task check` green with new tests.
narratives.UserStory: As a downstream TS consumer (e.g. vBRIEF tooling in another repo), I want `import type { … } from '@deftai/directive-types'` and a published JSON Schema so I stop hand-mirroring the vBRIEF shape and drifting from directive's canonical contract.
narratives.OutOfScope: v1 explicitly excludes: `@deftai/directive-core` as a supported library API, MCP/in-process engine export (#1707), and #2087 automation-declaration schema (cross-link only; v1.1 follow-up). Publishing all 11 auxiliary schemas beyond documented v1 subset is follow-up unless required for contract drift.

items.title: Real vBRIEF contract types replace #1717 skeleton

narrative.Acceptance: Given `@deftai/directive-types` is built, when a consumer imports the public entrypoint, then exported types include the vBRIEF document model (not merely `EngineInfo`), reference types (`x-vbrief/*`), and typed policy fields; `packages/types/src/index.ts` no longer describes itself as a Wave-1 skeleton-only package.

items.title: JSON Schema artifacts ship from npm

narrative.Acceptance: Given `npm pack @deftai/directive-types`, when the tarball is inspected, then it includes `vbrief-core-0.6.schema.json` (or equivalent subpath) matching `content/vbrief/schemas/vbrief-core.schema.json`; package.json exports document the schema subpath(s).

Given a deliberate mismatch between TS contract definitions and the canonical JSON Schema, when `task verify:contract-drift` (or wired equivalent in `task check`) runs, then it exits non-zero with an actionable message.
Given types/schema definitions for extension fields, when validated against deftai/vBRIEF#12 requirements, then `^x-[a-z0-9-]+/` extension keys round-trip preserve-verbatim (tests or gate cite #12).

Given maintainer docs are updated, when a consumer reads UPGRADING or conventions guidance, then supported public contract imports are `@deftai/directive-types` + published schemas; `@deftai/directive-core` is documented as unsupported library surface despite npm presence.

items.title: Install mirror vs npm channel clarified

narrative.Acceptance: Given docs describe both `deft` install-time `vbrief/schemas/` mirror and npm-published schemas, when read side-by-side, then single source of truth (`content/vbrief/schemas/`) and refresh path are unambiguous.

expected_outputs: JSON Schema artifacts in npm tarball with subpath exports
verify:contract-drift gate wired into task check
Consumer docs for import path and unsupported core API
